_comment: S47/S48 (ADR-145): the card rating — generated by pnpm rating:build from pnpm rating:run (analysis/runs, local). rating = prior(tier) + 0.5 × ½(presence′/σP + lift′/σL); see world/rating-build-cli.ts. presence and lift are raw win-rate differences; seen is the sample behind lift and castWhenDrawn. Post-S52 (v1.3, Chris 2026-10-05): each row also carries `limited` — the Limited score (rating-compute.ts computeLimitedRating: empirical Bayes on Limited games only, run.limited) — which every Limited path reads through limitedView; `rating` stays v1.1's and is the Constructed score.
